title: 据置式エクササイズバイク
description: 公共スポーツ施設やホテルジム向けの据置自転車型運動器具。固定足、フレーム、円形フライホイール外装、左右クランク・ペダルと固定ストラップ、座面調整外装、ハンドル・無表示コンソールを造形。移動用自転車とは異なる固定器具です。車輪走行、ペダル回転、負荷制御・運動計測はなく、安全・身体適合性や実機性能は未検証。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.750 × 1.304 × 1.000 m、8,020三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A stationary bicycle-form exercise prop for civic sports facilities and hotel gyms, with stabilizer feet, frame, circular flywheel housing, opposed cranks/pedals and fixed straps, saddle-adjustment exterior, handlebars and inactive console. It is fixed exercise equipment rather than a commuter bicycle. Rolling, pedaling, resistance control and exercise measurement are absent; safety, body fit and equipment performance are unvalidated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.750 × 1.304 × 1.000 m; 8,020 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
